name: DeltaLogic
description: Reasoning benchmarks typically evaluate whether a model derives the correct answer from a fixed premise set, but they under-measure a closely related capability that matters in dynamic environments: belief revision under minimal evidence change. We introduce DeltaLogic, a benchmark transformation protocol that converts natural-language reasoning examples into short revision episodes. Each episode first asks for an initial conclusion under premises P, then applies a minimal edit δ(P), and finally asks whether the previous conclusion should remain stable or be revised.
